question: In a certain code language, ‘BYE’ is written as ‘32’ and ‘ANGER’ is written as ‘45’. How will ‘LOVE’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘BYE’ is written as ‘32’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28c6d8160092794f68813dacc31dd4ba7252a9d98a5ccb35ef3f47ad7f240042.png] 

And,

‘ANGER’ is written as ‘45’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85a0aa343be6701cde569be3620ac2a62855c2c5cf6d9f0d92b34a07a06be8c7.png] 

Similarly,

‘LOVE’ will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6707024a70ff4d4f7e9b132cb1a396d162a8443a309ca651e06a087d7b3cfa3.png] 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
